proof_body:
by
  intro a M c h h₁
  have hu : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, h⟩
  have h₂ := Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt h₁ hu
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.1 h₂
  exact ⟨N, fun n hn => hN n hn⟩
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (M c : ℝ), (∀ n, a n ≤ M) → Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop < c → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → a n < c
